subject.title: WORKING: All Microsoft Issues and PRs (refresh)

question: Should OpenClaw source own a GitHub CLI workflow that classifies repository-wide Microsoft work and mutates arbitrary PR bodies, or should that workflow live in ClawSweeper/maintainer automation outside this repository?
rationale: The answer determines the permanent ownership, safety controls, review process, and whether the proposed script should exist in this repository; code review cannot safely infer that product and operational boundary.

options.title: Keep it outside OpenClaw
options.body: Move the tracker and any PR-body mutation workflow to the maintainer automation owner, leaving OpenClaw free of a bespoke repository-triage tool.

options.title: Accept a bounded OpenClaw tool
options.body: Keep a read-only generator in this repository but remove PR mutation and release-note changes, with deterministic output checks and documented ownership.

options.title: Accept full mutation workflow
options.body: Keep the GitHub-mutating mode only after maintainers explicitly define its authorization, escaping, validation, and operational ownership contract.

recommendation.title: Keep it outside OpenClaw
recommendation.body: Move the tracker and any PR-body mutation workflow to the maintainer automation owner, leaving OpenClaw free of a bespoke repository-triage tool.

likelyOwner.reason: The recent direct mention and the repository-level ownership question make this the strongest available routing signal.
